project_type: Django 4.x monolith, single-app POS system for a cafe
build_system: pip / requirements.txt, no build step for Python; static files via WhiteNoise. CSS/JS served as-is from static/. No Webpack/bundler.
test_framework: pytest-django (inferred from Django project). Run: python manage.py test  OR  pytest --ds=kape_de_manubag.settings
build_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
verification_instructions: 1. python manage.py migrate (no-op for FEAT-001 since ROLE_CHOICES is not a DB constraint, but creates the kitchen app migration). 2. python manage.py runserver. 3. Create a kitchen_staff user via Staff Accounts. 4. Log in as kitchen_staff — should land at /kitchen/. 5. Manual access to /dashboard/ or /orders/manage/ as kitchen_staff should redirect with 'Access denied'. 6. Accept an order as cashier → verify it appears in kitchen page in realtime.
snapshot_or_generated_files: staticfiles/ (collectstatic output) — regenerated by collectstatic, not committed. db.sqlite3 — dev DB, not committed.
environment_constraints: Single-worker WSGI process assumed (PythonAnywhere / Render free tier). In-memory SSE broker (apps/realtime/broker.py) is the existing realtime system — do NOT add Redis or Celery. All new SSE events go through the existing broker.publish() function. Do NOT restart the dev server between steps.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing decorator pattern for role guards (see apps/accounts/decorators.py). Follow existing URL namespacing (app_name). Follow existing realtime event pattern (broker.publish + signals.py). No new authentication system. No second User model. Do not change Admin or Cashier behavior.
key_patterns: - Role property naming: is_admin_user, is_cashier, is_customer — new property must be is_kitchen_staff. - ROLE_CHOICES tuples: ('admin','Admin'), ('cashier','Cashier'), ('customer','Customer'). Add ('kitchen_staff','Kitchen Staff'). - Decorator pattern: @login_required + @role_required stacked, redirect to appropriate fallback URL. cashier_or_admin_required redirects non-staff to 'menu:index'; new kitchen_staff_required redirects to 'menu:index'. - SSE broker: broker.publish(event_type: str, data: dict) — in-memory pub/sub, no return value. - realtime.js: RealtimeConnection.on('event_name', callback) registers a handler. The SSE stream endpoint at /realtime/stream/ requires cashier_or_admin_required — a new /realtime/kitchen-stream/ endpoint is needed for kitchen_staff. - Order status flow: awaiting_payment (unpaid) → payment confirmed (is_paid=True, still awaiting_payment) → cashier accepts (status=preparing) → kitchen marks ready (status=ready) → cashier completes (status=completed). There is NO 'accepted' status. 'preparing' IS the post-acceptance state. - status_changed signal: fires on every Order.save() via apps/realtime/signals.py. It publishes to ALL subscribers including the new kitchen stream. - ready_at field: already exists on Order model (DateTimeField, null=True). - Migration numbering: accounts app is at 0004, orders app is at 0019 (check before coding). - StaffCreateForm has hardcoded choices=[('cashier','Cashier'),('admin','Admin')] — must add ('kitchen_staff','Kitchen Staff'). - staff_list view filters role__in=['admin','cashier'] — must add 'kitchen_staff'. - password_reset_request filters role__in=['admin','cashier'] — must add 'kitchen_staff'. - base_admin.html is the existing staff sidebar template (extends base.html). Kitchen Staff gets a NEW base_kitchen.html template. - Sounds: static/sounds/new_order.mp3 and static/sounds/order_ready.mp3 both exist. Kitchen uses order_ready.mp3 for new-order-ready-for-kitchen notification, new_order.mp3 for 'marked ready' confirmation. - CSS badge classes already exist: .badge-preparing (blue), .badge-ready (green). - _default_login_redirect in accounts/views.py returns dashboard:index for admin/cashier. Must add kitchen_staff branch returning 'kitchen:orders'.
directory_structure: kape_de_manubag_system/ — project root. apps/ — all Django apps (accounts, audit, menu, orders, inventory, reports, dashboard, realtime, finance, chatbot). templates/ — all templates at top level. templates/base.html — bare HTML shell. templates/base_admin.html — staff sidebar layout (extends base.html). static/js/ — realtime.js, main.js. static/css/ — main.css. static/sounds/ — notification sounds. kape_de_manubag/ — Django project package (settings.py, urls.py).
